body:
OBSERVED at runtime, 2026-08-23, same instance and same task in both UIs.

`render_task_status` (`cps/tasks_status.py:41-79`) puts BOTH fields in the payload the SPA
already fetches — `ret['starttime']` at line 48 and `ret['error']` at line 74 — and
`/api/v1/tasks` (`cps/api/info.py:60-67`) returns it verbatim.

Live payload from `GET /api/v1/tasks` after a send to an unreachable mail host:

  "error": "Socket Error sending e-mail: Name or service not known",
  "starttime": "2026-08-23 21:15",
  "status": "Failed",

`frontend/src/pages/Tasks.tsx:37-59` enumerates exactly five columns — Task, User, Status,
Progress, Run time — plus a Cancel cell, and never reads either field. Classic binds both:
`cps/templates/tasks.html:20-21` (`data-field="starttime"`, `data-field="error"`).

Rendered, same moment:

  /tasks       Start Time "2026-08-23 21:15" | Message "Socket Error sending e-mail: Name or service not known"
  /app/tasks   neither column exists

So in the new UI a failed conversion or send says "Failed" and nothing else, and the reason is
sitting unused in the response the page already has. This is the same defect class as F-c6b236
(the deletion core's failure detail discarded on the way to the user), reached by a different
route: there the server threw the reason away, here the client does.

Fix is frontend-only — no API change needed for these two fields.
title: New UI Tasks drops the start time and the failure message it already receives
